mapper.sql: from family_member_elder binding inner join family_member fm on fm.id = binding.family_member_id inner join elder on elder.id = binding.elder_id
mapper.select:
select binding.id, binding.family_member_id as familyMemberId, binding.elder_id as elderId, elder.name as elderName
where binding.family_member_id = #{familyMemberId} order by binding.id

select binding.id as mid, binding.remark as mremark, elder.id as elderId, elder.name, elder.image, coalesce(bed.bed_number, elder.bed_number) as bedNumber, room.type_name as typeName, wearable.iot_id as iotId, wearable.device_name as deviceName, wearable.product_key as productKey
left join bed on bed.id = elder.bed_id left join room on room.id = bed.room_id and room.is_deleted = 0
left join device wearable on wearable.binding_location = concat('', elder.id) and wearable.location_type = 0 where binding.family_member_id = #{familyMemberId} order by binding.id
